{{Quote|I ''knew'' it was a mistake to allow ''your'' kind onto the Council.''"<br />"''Please, General Immodet&hellip;|Immodet and "[[Feena D'Asta (clone)|Feena D'Asta]]"|<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Immodet''' was an elderly [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and one of the funders of [[Carnor Jax]]'s plan to sabotage [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Cloning/Legends|Clones]]. After Palpatine's death, Immodet became a member on Jax's [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The "Council of Blood"|Interim Ruling Council]]. After the death of [[Redd Wessel]], Immodet was the highest-ranking general in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. His troops occupied several entire [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] along the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] frontier and provided a first line of defense.

A staunch [[Speciesism|xenophobist]], he was very suspicious of the aliens on the council. Immodet was poisoned by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in an effort to increase the power of their agent within the council, a [[Feena D'Asta (clone)|clone]] of [[Feena D'Asta]].
